bir.subtitle: Thoughtful Reshaping.
bir.heroDesc: Breast implants are not lifetime devices. Whether for comfort, health, or lifestyle, Dr. Soma performs safe explant surgery to restore natural proportions and peace of mind.
bir.whatIsDesc1: Also known as <highlight>explant surgery</highlight>, this procedure removes one or both breast implants. Depending on the condition of the implant and the surrounding capsule (the natural scar tissue layer the body forms), the surgery is tailored to your specific needs.
bir.whatIsDesc2: A safe plan starts with a proper assessment, not assumptions. Dr. Soma evaluates breast tissue, implant type, and capsule condition to determine if you need:
bir.capsuleDesc: A capsule is a scar tissue layer that naturally forms around any implant. It is normal. However, problems occur when it thickens, tightens, or becomes inflamed. Not every patient needs a full capsulectomy, but specific conditions like contracture or calcification require it.
bir.capsuleCard0Desc: Tightness, pain, or distortion caused by a shrinking capsule.
bir.capsuleCard1Desc: Hard deposits that can form in long-standing implants.
bir.capsuleCard2Desc: Dr. Soma decides between partial, total, or en bloc removal based on safety.
bir.optionsDesc: Explant is not one-size-fits-all. Dr. Soma will recommend the most suitable option based on your tissue quality and goals.
bir.option0Desc: Best for patients with good natural tissue and minimal sagging. The natural breast will settle over time.
bir.option1Desc: Recommended when the capsule is thick, painful, or abnormal. Improves comfort and tissue mobility.
bir.option2Desc: Remove old implants and replace with new ones to adjust size, fix asymmetry, or correct malposition.
bir.option3Desc: Uses your own fat to add modest volume and softness without new implants.
bir.featuredDesc: Best if sagging or loose skin is expected after removal. This creates a more youthful breast position by repositioning the nipple and tightening the skin envelope.
bir.recoveryDesc: Typical healing process for standard explant surgery.
bir.recoveryNote: Most patients return to desk work in 1-2 weeks
bir.source0Desc: Discusses removal for complications like rupture and contracture, emphasizing individualized planning.
bir.source1Desc: Outlines that implants are not lifetime devices and explains the assessment process for complications.
bir.source2Desc: Clinical literature on capsulectomy techniques, rupture management, and post-explant reshaping.
bir.faq0A: Not always. Capsulectomy is recommended when the capsule is thick, tight, painful, or abnormal. If the tissue is healthy and thin, simple removal may suffice. Dr. Soma will advise you based on safety.
bir.faq1Q: Will my breasts sag after removal?
bir.faq1A: Sagging depends on your skin elasticity and how large the implants were. If significant sagging is expected, a breast lift (mastopexy) can be performed simultaneously to reshape the breast.
bir.faq2A: Most patients describe the pain as mild to moderate, often less than the original augmentation. Tightness is common in the first week. Oral medication is usually sufficient.
bir.faq3Q: Can I replace them with smaller implants?
bir.faq3A: Yes. This is called an Implant Exchange. It allows you to downsize while maintaining some fullness. Pocket repair may be needed to ensure the smaller implant sits correctly.
bir.faq4Q: How long before I can return to work?
bir.faq4A: Desk work is often possible within 1-2 weeks. Full physical activity typically resumes after 4-6 weeks with guidance.
bir.faq5A: Drains are used only in selected cases, depending on the complexity of the capsulectomy and individual factors.
bir.faq6Q: Can implants be removed and replaced in one surgery?
bir.faq6A: Yes, implant exchange is an option if desired. This can be discussed during your consultation.
bir.faq7A: Yes. Once removed, implants are gone unless you choose to have new ones placed in a future procedure.
bir.pricingDesc: Costs vary based on complexity. Key factors include:
bir.pricingItem1: Need for Lift or Fat Transfer
bir.testimonialText: My capsular contracture pain is gone. The whole process felt safe and professional.
bir.ctaDesc: Dr. Soma combines medical precision with aesthetic judgement to ensure your explant journey is safe, comfortable, and results in a natural look.
